title: heuristic-synthesizer-and-quant-integrity-guard: bootstrap cost heuristics from telemetry
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a telemetry-driven heuristic synthesizer for tenant defaults and a quant integrity guard that detects and repairs invalid quant profiles. Exposes a dry-run CLI and admin API for previewing suggested defaults. No breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: customers keep hitting local cost spikes after rolling out aggressive quant profiles and batch defaults derived from synthetic workloads. We need a production-facing path to synthesize conservative heuristics from real telemetry and prevent bad quant profiles from being accepted. This PR introduces two pieces: 1) heuristic-synthesizer: an offline/cron service that consumes per-tenant inference telemetry (latency, tail-percentiles, token distribution, cache hit ratios) and produces ranked heuristic candidates for batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles; heuristics are exported as JSON manifests suitable for import into tenant defaults-as-code. 2) quant-integrity-guard: validation and sanitization logic run at profile import time and as a pre-apply check in the console/CLI. It flags extremely aggressive bitwidth changes, incompatible operator patterns, and empirically unsafe quant combos based on historical regression signals and recent eval snapshots. The PR also adds a preview CLI (redwood heuristics dry-run) that runs the synthesizer locally against a sampling export and prints expected unit-econ deltas. Implementation notes: the synthesizer runs as a small Go worker (cmd/heuristicsync) using existing telemetry ingestion libraries; heuristics are represented with the new compact heuristic schema heuristics/v1 which is backwards-compatible with defaults-as-code. The integrity guard hooks into the profile import path (pkg/quant/guard) and the console import flow to provide warnings with suggested rollbacks. Tests: unit tests for the core scoring function, integration test that runs the CLI against a synthetic export, and a load test to validate worker backpressure. Rollout plan: feature-flag the synthesizer and guard; enable dry-run globally; keep conservative defaults unless user explicitly accepts suggestions. Backwards compatibility: no changes to public inference API. See linked Linear tasks ENG-2345 (synthesizer design) and ENG-3001 (guard rules).
commits: 3 commits: 1) init: add heuristicsync worker, heuristic schema and CLI glue (Asha Patel) 2) quant: add integrity guard validators and repair helpers (Miguel Torres) 3) tests: add unit + integration + load test harness and docs (Evelyn Chen)
patch_snippets: pkg/heuristics/synthesizer.go: Add scoring pipeline that ingests telemetry.Stream and outputs ranked heuristics. The logic favors small step-changes and prefers cache TTL increases before batch-size increases.
pkg/quant/guard.go: Add ValidateProfile(profile) -> (warnings, errors) with heuristics to detect abrupt bitwidth reductions and operator-mismatch patterns.
cmd/cli/heuristics_dryrun.go: New command 'redwood heuristics dry-run --sample path' that prints recommended heuristics and estimated cost delta.
review_thread: Miguel Torres: Can the scoring function be parameterized per-tenant activity profile? Asha: Yes — added a tenant multiplier and a CLI flag --tenant-profile to seed the run. Miguel: Please add a short-circuit that avoids recommending profile changes for tenants with fewer than 24h of telemetry. Asha: Added threshold and test. Evelyn Chen: The repair helper currently mutates the profile in-place; prefer returning a patched copy to avoid accidental persistence. Miguel: Also request logging of the evidence that triggered each sanity fix. Asha: Updated repair helpers to return a copy and emit structured evidence logs. Samir Rao: CI flaked on the load test (OOM). Asha: increased test worker memory and added backpressure handling; re-ran. Evelyn Chen: Approved after tests green. Samir Rao: Small nit: add an example in docs showing a rejected quant profile and the guard's suggested patch. Asha: Doc snippet added. Approvals: Miguel Torres (approved), Evelyn Chen (approved), Samir Rao (approved).
ci_checks: ci/integration — failed on first run (load test OOM), rerun passed
notes_on_ci: Integration load test failed first run due to low memory in the runner; increased heap for the worker and added stronger backpressure in synthesizer; subsequent run passed. e2e-console is flaky on the experimental windows matrix and will be tracked separately under ENG-3010.
tests_summary: Unit: added 18 new tests covering scoring buckets and repair helpers. Integration: dry-run against a 24h sample export validated no regressions and returned conservative heuristics. Load: validated worker stays under 2GB for 1000 sample streams per minute with backpressure enabled.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: Changes are behind a feature flag and import guard is opt-in by default. The quant guard can block profile imports; added a bypass workflow for emergency ops and a clear audit log of guard decisions.
docs_summary: New admin doc 'heuristic-synthesizer.md' describing architecture, sampling guidance, CLI usage, and example manifests. Added console import UX notes and example error messages produced by the guard.
migration_instructions: Ops: To enable, flip feature flag heuristics.synthesizer=true in the control plane, ensure telemetry exports are configured for target tenants, and run 'redwood heuristics dry-run --sample <export>' to preview suggestions. To rollback, disable feature flag and delete queued suggestions via admin UI.
release_blockers: None — feature gated. Must coordinate with the telemetry infra team to ensure sample export schema (telemetry/v2) is available in prod before enabling for >10 tenants.
changelog_entry: Added heuristics synthesizer and quant integrity guard behind feature flag; CLI dry-run available for admins.
